lcc_original: 塞特活到一百零五歲，生了以挪士。
notes: LCC and UNV texts for this verse are lexically identical, so all SN tags map 1-to-1 with no reordering or rephrasing decisions required.
WH08141 (שָׁנָה, year) appears twice — once attached to 一百 (reflecting the Hebrew construct 'hundred of years') and once to 歲 (the explicit 'years' word); this dual attachment is preserved from UNV.
The direct object marker {<WAH0853>} (אֵת) remains implicit in LCC just as in UNV — neither version has an explicit Chinese word for it.
